SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
794
Station Ref. No.412.
B'well Station,
REPORT
Date May 26, 1933.
Subject Explosion in the garden of the Soviet Embassy
No.1607 Hart Road.
Made by D.S.I. Maklaevsky Forwarded by Inspector Clissold.

Sir,
At 8.20 p.m. the 26-5-33 a telephone message
was received from S.P.C. 459, who was on duty outside the Soviet
Embassy No.1607 Hart Road, to the effect that some trouble had
occurred at the Soviet Embassy. At 8.23 p.m. the similar message
was received from Inspector Robinson, residing at No.154 Sinza
Road in the neighbourhood of the Embassy. S.I. Archer went there
with C.D.C. 314 and knocked the gate on Hart Road and after some
time the gate was opened by a male Russian whom S.I. Archer asked
what was the trouble. The man replied that a cracker or a bomb
had been thrown from the road into the grounds and he pointed in
the direction of the front door of the building which is situated
inside the compound. He said that it was made of wood, paper and
gun powder. S.I. Archer wanted to go in and see the spot where
the bomb or cracker had fallen, but was told that he could not do
so as it was an Embassy. S.I. Archer then requested that parts of
the bomb or cracker be shown to him which was also refused. On
returning to the Station, S.I. Archer received a message from the
Embassy at 8.35 p.m. reporting that a Chinese bomb of a heavy type
had been thrown into the grounds and requesting the Police to
investigate. On receiving the above message, Inspector Chamberlain
S.I. Archer, S.P.C. 599 and the undersigned went to the Embassy
where we were met by J.J. Angarsky, a member of the Embassy, who
stated that at about 8.15 p.m. when they had a dinner they heard
an explosion which took place in the rockery which is situated
in the garden about 10 yards from the house. He then handed over
a small piece of dirty white cloth and several pieces of paper
which were picked up on the rockery and which are the remnants of
a bomb or a cracker. The rockery was carefully examined with

百老汇路巡捕房，
报告
日期 1933年5月26日。
事由 赫德路1607号苏联大使馆花园内发生爆炸事件
由 副督察马卡耶夫斯基（Maklaevsky）呈报 经 克里索尔德（Clissold）督察转呈。

先生：
1933年5月26日晚8时20分，接到在赫德路1607号苏联大使馆外执勤的459号西捕的电话留言，称苏联大使馆发生了一些骚乱。晚8时23分，住在大使馆附近新闸路154号的罗宾逊（Robinson）督察也发来了类似的消息。副督察阿彻（Archer）偕同314号华探目前往该处，敲击赫德路的大门，过了一会儿，一名俄国男子打开了大门，副督察阿彻询问发生了何事。该男子回答说，有人从路上向院内扔了一个爆竹或炸弹，并指向位于大院内部的建筑物前门方向。他说那是用木头、纸和火药制成的。副督察阿彻想进去查看炸弹或爆竹落下的地点，但被告知因这里是大使馆，他不能进入。副督察阿彻随即要求查看炸弹或爆竹的残片，这也遭到了拒绝。返回巡捕房后，副督察阿彻于晚8时35分收到大使馆发来的消息，称一枚重型中式炸弹被扔进院内，并请警方进行调查。收到上述消息后，张伯伦（Chamberlain）督察、副督察阿彻、599号西捕及本人前往大使馆，受到大使馆成员J.J. Angarsky（音译）的接待，他表示大约在晚8时15分，他们正在吃晚饭时，听到一声爆炸，爆炸发生在距离房屋约10码的花园中的假山上。随后，他移交了一小块脏白布和几张纸片，这些是从假山上拾得的炸弹或爆竹的残留物。假山经过仔细检查，使用

torchlight, but no signs of explosion could be seen amongst the
rochery nor was the earth disturbed, which may have supported the
fact that a bomb or cracker had fallen and exploded there. No
other fragments, besides a piece of cloth and several pieces of
paper, could be found. Neither of the tenants of the Embassy saw
a bomb or cracker landing on the rochery or direction where it
came from, they all heard only explosion. One Chinese servant
Cha Ah Loong (          ) 55, Ningpo, said that when he was
coming out the house into the garden, he heard the sound of
explosion and saw flames in the rochery. J.J. Angarsky further
stated that they regarded the matter as trivial and did not want
to report to the Police, but as an European Inspector, after the
explosion occurred, came at the gate and enquired re. it, they
decided to inform the Police. The above Inspector referred to is
Inspector Robinson, who having heard an explosion in the Embassy,
came up and knocked the gate, but was not let in and was told by
a male Russian, through a small window in the gate, similar story
as S.I. Archer. On leaving the grounds of the Embassy Inspector
Chamberlain asked J.J. Angarsky whether he wished that the Police
outside the Embassy be increased, but he replied in negative.
S.P.C. 459 and C.P.C. 261 who were on duty outside the Embassy
stated that they did not see any suspects loitering in the vici-
nity of the Embassy nor they saw any one throwing anything into t
the grounds of the Embassy. C.P.C. 261 was on duty at the gate on
Hart Road while S.P.C. 459 was farther on the corner of Hart Road
and Sinza Road, having all area of the Embassy under surveillance
and both are positively certain that none approached the either
side of the Embassy. They further stated that after an explosion
took place in the grounds of the Embassy, they knocked the gate

Angarsky（音译）进一步表示，他们认为此事微不足道，本不想向警方报告，但由于一位洋人督察在爆炸发生后来到门口询问此事，他们决定通知警方。上述提到的督察是指罗宾逊（Robinson）督察，他在听到大使馆内的爆炸声后前来敲门，但未被允许进入，并通过大门上的小窗从一名俄国男子那里听到了与副督察阿彻所闻类似的说法。离开大使馆院区时，张伯伦（Chamberlain）督察询问J.J. Angarsky（音译）是否希望增加大使馆外的警力，但他予以否定回答。在大使馆外执勤的459号西捕和261号华捕表示，他们未看到任何嫌疑人在大使馆附近徘徊，也未看到任何人向大使馆院内投掷物品。261号华捕在赫德路的大门口执勤，而459号西捕则在更远处的赫德路与新闸路拐角处执勤，对大使馆整个区域进行监视，两人均肯定无人接近大使馆的任何一侧。他们还表示，在大使馆院内发生爆炸后，他们敲击大门
